pages.title: Lymph Tissue
pages.text: Packed lymphocytes and the mesh that holds them, where invaders are shown to the cells that will fight them. Found on the surface of Inner Space's Lymph Node. The Antibody Bench raises Memory Cells from it; matrix and a memory cell make more.
